name: governed-cognition
title: Governed Cognition
description: The default theme — the April palette as the named instance: deep slate substrate, signal teal structure, system cyan info, convergence green stability, commit gold threshold, integrity red violation, intent magenta. Values are extracted from Diadem's theme-default.css so Diadem renders identically under this theme: the odysseus-inherited cockpit is formally re-grounded here — its teal was signal teal all along, lineage now attributed.

family.mono: 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

notes.extraction: Every color/shape/motion/type value that exists in diadem/static/theme-default.css is byte-equal here (enforced by tests/test_extraction.py). Diadem's layout constants (--sp-*, --sidebar-w, --spine-*, etc.) and fine-grained font steps are app-local structure, not theme identity, and deliberately stay in Diadem.
notes.april_lineage: Where Diadem's current values ARE the April family: teal #00B3A4 ~ Signal Teal #1FB6A6 (structure/focus); blue #4CC9F0 ~ System Cyan #38BDF8 (info); green #A4F000 carries the Convergence Green #22C55E role; amber #FFC857 ~ Commit Gold #FBBF24 (threshold); red #E10600 ~ Integrity Red #EF4444 (violation); magenta #FF2F92 ~ Intent Magenta #D946EF (intent). The roles are April doctrine; the hues are the odysseus/neo-andean-derived cockpit values, lineage attributed per the spec.
notes.info_choice: info = --blue #4CC9F0 (the syntax key / info channel), not --cyan #66E6FF, which stays a theme-private extra.
notes.scrollbar: Keeper-ruled 2026-08-29: scrollbars are quiet structure, not signal — dim muted-family thumb (hover slightly brighter), track on panel. Intentionally diverges from diadem's odysseus-inherited amber thumb (style.css var(--amber)); recorded as keeper-ruled divergence entry 1 in tests/test_extraction.py.
notes.ai_usage_sets: series-rank values are the tracker's proven UNIFIED_RANK_COLORS array verbatim (index.html, ten hues evenly spread, no near-duplicates) — provenance, not invention, per the kintsugi render. UNIFIED_MODEL_COLORS differed (a six-hue wrap of the SERIES palette); per the ruled spec, ranks take RANK_COLORS. harness values are picked from the cockpit's own :root hues: claude_code = the teal the Claude comparison line already wore, claude_code_secondary = the spark-weekly purple, hermes = gold, opencode = sky.
